name: shop-checkout
label: BFB Shop checkout
on: Bricks' own Checkout customer details (`woocommerce-checkout-customer-details`), Checkout order review (`woocommerce-checkout-order-review`), Checkout thank you (`woocommerce-checkout-thankyou`), `woocommerce-checkout-v2`, `woocommerce-form-field`
job: the shop's settings on Bricks' Checkout customer details, Order review and Thank you (and the 2.4 v2 checkout): the table and fields look, floating labels, your own checkout fields and their date pickers, delivery days and time slots, the payment list
